notes: Coordinates are pixels of the file they belong to; keys ending in Base are in the 1920x1080 frame base.

frame-top-center.role: menu button + clock slots; centre of the piece = screen centre

frame-top-a.role: top bar between resource corner and centre piece (stretch horizontally)

frame-top-b.role: top bar between centre piece and right corner (stretch horizontally)

frame-side-left.role: left side bar (stretch vertically) from top-left piece down to the side decoration

frame-side-left-deco.role: small bracket decoration on the left edge; sits directly above frame-bottom-left

frame-side-right-deco.role: small bracket decoration on the right edge; sits directly above frame-bottom-right

frame-bottom.role: bottom edge strip between the two bottom blocks (stretch horizontally)

frameLayout.summary: Width W, height H. Fixed pieces keep 1:1 size. top-center is centred (x = W/2 - 104). frame-top-a spans from x=388 to the left edge of top-center, frame-top-b from the right edge of top-center to W-230 (stretch horizontally). frame-bottom-left/-right are anchored to the bottom corners; frame-bottom fills between them (stretch horizontally), anchored at y = H-64. frame-side-left/-right fill from y=130 down to the top of the side deco; the deco sits directly above the bottom block (y = H-335-147).

statsPanelHintBase.note: stats panel (255 px wide) sits above the minimap block, its bottom edge overlaps the top of frame-bottom-right

productionPanelHintBase.note: top-left corner of the production panel under the resource bar

frame-bottom-left.note: idle buttons sit above this piece (y < 0 locally): see idleButtonSlotsBase

production.summary: Stack: production_top (256) + M x production_mid (40) + production_bottom (133) = 389 + 40*M px high, 316 wide. Mid strips only add plain inner area, so children can be positioned independent of where the strips sit.
production.optionGridNote: 4x4 cells of 60 px, panel coordinates from the top edge of production_top (fits in the panel for M=0: plain inner area reaches y=356 when M=0, +40 per mid strip)
production.queueNote: Use M = number of queue rows (incl. a "+N" row). Queue row i occupies y = 318 + 40*i in panel coordinates. The mid strip alone has its text-safe area at queueRowInMid.

insets.note: frame thickness; plain inner area extends from the inset edges

stats.summary: Stack: stats_top (44) + N x stats_row (19, one row per player, 2..8) + stats_bottom (9), 255 wide. Each row begins with a 1 px lighter separator line.

centerPanel.summary: Row: center_panel_left (142) + K x center_panel_mid (49, tile horizontally) + center_panel_right (269); 183 high. Inner area = left margin 44 .. right margin 66.
centerPanel.note: inner area for total width Wc: x = 44, y = 41, w = Wc - 44 - 66, h = 183 - 41 - 14

left.note: everything up to the left ends of the label boxes: left column, hologram, leader lines, label box left ends and header texts area start

mid.note: one exact period of the plain part (horizontal lines + fill), seamless; may be cropped to any width >= 0 (background-repeat: repeat-x from its left edge)

right.note: right ends of the label boxes incl. //// and the right frame edge

robotPanel.layout: total width Wt >= minWidth: left at x=0, right at x=Wt-right.w, mid fills [left.w, Wt-right.w) repeating/cropping. All x/y below are in left-piece coordinates (= panel coordinates for x < left.w). rightInset = distance of a right edge from the right edge of the whole panel, so width = Wt - x - rightInset.

legacyFile.note: left + right without mid (old 1252x480 single image), only kept for the old layout code

robotPanel.displayHint: show at height 320 css px at 1080p (= asset size * 2/3 * hud scale); panel width ~1250 css px = 1875 asset px
robotPanel.maskNote: white, alpha = hologram brightness (peak ~0.95), tight crops positioned at x,y inside robot-panel.png; partition of the hologram without overlap. head = crew, leftArm = robot left = viewer right. Tint with CSS mask-image + background-color; base image already shows the hologram at 15 % brightness (= part missing).
robotPanel.paintedOver: CONTROL, LEFT ARM, RIGHT ARM, CREW, the three decorative // bars, CREW/BODY/R. ARM/L. ARM/LEGS headers

tile.note: horizontally tileable yellow/black stripes (colours are NOT affected by the blue hue filter if used outside the filtered layer)

bar.note: the ready-made framed bar (dark outline, blue edge) incl. transparent corners
